# The Cost of Link-Only Culture — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-tofr-52127
Voiceover: The frame is not neutral delivery: pose, setting, crop, light, garment, commission, and publication context combine to manufacture a public fashion meaning.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Toni Frissell Collection, Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

Rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

### 8–16s — CO12-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · DEPEND — Which memory exists only elsewhere?. Inventory source URL, platform, account owner, identifier, format, access condition, geography, login, cost, rights, and evidence use.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO12-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · PERMIT — What may lawfully be retained?. Separate public visibility, download ability, license, authorized embed, preservation copy, quotation, metadata, and link. Review contracts and jurisdiction where uncertain.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO12-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · DESCRIBE — What survives without the media?. Write a faithful factual description, creator and institution credit, date, identifier, evidentiary relevance, rights status, and retrieval history without substituting invented imagery.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO12-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · RECOVER — What happens after failure?. Schedule link checks, preserve redirects and replacement records, document loss, contact stewards, update citations, and keep correction history.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
